random_simple.reason: Random split keeps same drugs in train, so B0p/B1k label signal is reliable; fusion adds expression-based B1 without much downside.

weakly_correlated.reason: Held-out drugs are expression-dissimilar to train, so B1k neighbor propagation and B0p counts transfer poorly; label-free B1 is safer.

interpretation: Choice made without outer-test metrics; benchmark scores must be checked separately.
